text.text_excerpt: This hotel is extremely nice when you first walk in. It's near the hospital and you can walk to multiple places to eat if you want to. They have a business area, a conference room, and a dining area for your complementary breakfast. The only thing I didn't like was the guy at the front desk. He was very helpful when we checked in, but I noticed that he doesn't acknowledge you until you ask something at the desk and he goes back to his phone after answering. Our housekeeper was extremely nice when we got back, she didn't have the chance to clean our room and she ask if we wanted her to clean our room first and it's ok for us to come in the room as she cleans. The place was clean and reasonably priced. It was a perfect base of operations for our most recent trip to NOLA. The lobby was modern, and the counter staff was super friendly. Our room was super clean. The view of the city was excellent. The only down side was the parking across the street in a moderately lit parking lot. Personal safety was my primary concern. The elevators were somewhat scary and jerky at times. We will definitely stay there again.

This hotel is relatively new. The room furnishings are middle tier quality, but they come across better than that since they are new. The mattress is very comfortable. The shower spray is strong but the shower door doesn't seal well, so drying the floor is necessary. The walls are thin. Adjoining conversations can be heard. This was an issue one night out of three. Otherwise, it was very quiet. On the 10th floor, we never heard street traffic. Bathroom toiletries exceeded expectations with goat's milk soap, and quality shampoo.
